int_name: BENJAMIN FRANKLIN PKWY & LOGAN CIR W

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and a high-visibility continental crosswalk in an institutional setting. However, the crossing lacks visible active traffic controls or warning signage to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks visible regulatory or warning signage, which may lead to low driver yielding rates.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install R1-6 'Yield to Pedestrians' in-street signs or W11-2 warning signs to increase driver awareness at the crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features wide, well-maintained sidewalks and a dedicated green bike lane, providing good separation from traffic. However, the multi-lane curved roadway creates a significant crossing distance and potential visibility issues due to curbside parking.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane road increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing area across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb near the intersection can block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb line.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility for all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with high-visibility continental crosswalk markings and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance and wide roadway geometry prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort and safety.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross multiple lanes of traffic in a single stage, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the wide roadway

hazards.name: Worn Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are cracked and showing signs of wear, which may reduce visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The environment features a wide, multi-lane roadway with significant crossing distances and a lack of marked pedestrian crossings. While sidewalks and a painted bike lane are present, the overall design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a large expanse of asphalt without any refuge.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks at this wide junction, leaving pedestrians unprotected.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the middle ground
